Name: Flying Slime Helper
Author: PixelMoonMods
Description:
[b][size=5]FlyingSlime Helper[/size][/b]

Meet your new farmhand: a cute [b]winged slime[/b] that lives in a nest on your farm and does the boring field work for you! Fill its nest with seeds and fertilizer, and it will fly out to fertilize your soil, plant your seeds and harvest your crops as soon as they are ready. It swallows the harvest (you can actually see it inside its jelly body!) and carries it to a [b]Drop Nest[/b], where you can collect everything at once.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Slime Nest[/b] – home of the winged slime. Holds seeds and fertilizer for your helper.[/*]
[*][b]Drop Nest[/b] – the slime delivers all harvested crops here.[/*]
[*][b]Fertilizes, plants and harvests[/b] – fully automatic, with cute flying, eating and spitting animations.[/*]
[*][b]Connector system[/b] – put any item into the connector slot of a nest. All nests with the same connector item are linked, so you can run several independent slime teams on one map.[/*]
[*][b]Work area editor[/b] – mark up to 30 tiles per slime. Left-click and drag to add tiles, right-click and drag to remove them, WASD to move the view. Without a custom area, the slime takes care of the 30 nearest tilled tiles or garden pots.[/*]
[*][b]Works everywhere[/b] – fields, greenhouse, sheds and other indoor locations, including [b]garden pots[/b] and [b]mixed seeds[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Teamwork[/b] – multiple slimes never fly to the same tile.[/*]
[*]Available in [b]English[/b] and [b]German[/b].[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Recipes[/b][/size]
You learn both recipes automatically.
[list]
[*][b]Slime Nest:[/b] 5 Iridium Bars, 50 Slime, 10 Bat Wings[/*]
[*][b]Drop Nest:[/b] 5 Gold Bars, 20 Slime[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Craft a Slime Nest and a Drop Nest and place them on the same map.[/*]
[*]Put the same connector item into both nests (e.g. a gem or any other item you like).[/*]
[*]Fill the Slime Nest with seeds and/or fertilizer.[/*]
[*]Optional: click "Work area" in the nest menu to choose exactly which tiles your slime should take care of.[/*]
[*]Lean back and watch your slime work![/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Install SMAPI, unzip the mod into your [i]Mods[/i] folder and start the game through SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]In multiplayer, the slimes are simulated by the host.[/*]
[*]Console commands: [i]slime_reload[/i] (reloads textures and data), [i]slime_debug[/i] (shows what every slime is currently doing – very helpful for bug reports!).[/*]
[/list]Found a bug or have an idea? Feel free to leave a comment or open a bug report!
